effect.name: Codebook (Switch)
effect.description: This effect is an attempt to recreate the "Codebook" effect from the Paint.NET PolyGlitch plugin created by gsuberland.
effect.author: Foxioo, (Special thanks to: gsuberland)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Codebook (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.23 */
parameter.description: This effect is an attempt to recreate the "Codebook" effect from the Paint.NET PolyGlitch plugin created by gsuberland.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines which color will be the basis for modification. Set to 0 means it will be the texture of the object and set to 1 it will be the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Seed
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the randomness of the pattern, depending on the seed.
